captions.detailed: This high-performance vacuum blender features a wide, rectangular black motor base with rounded corners and a blue rectangular display on the front. Mounted on the base is a transparent, wide-mouth cylindrical jar with visible measurement markings on the side, resting in a black bayonet collar. Inside the bottom of the jar is a six-blade cross assembly on a revolute joint, and sealing the top is a flat black lid with a central hinged rectangular valve flap that operates on a revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a high-performance vacuum blender with a rectangular motor base, a cylindrical transparent jar, a six-blade cross assembly at the bottom, and a vacuum-seal lid with a hinged valve flap on top. Ensure the blades and the lid valve flap are modeled with realistic articulation joints.
captions.factory: The model is built using CadQuery primitives. The motor base is constructed from a filleted Box with a smaller blue Box representing the display screen. The jar collar is a Cylinder, and the jar itself is a hollowed-out transparent Cylinder with measurement tick marks added via small Box extrusions. The blade assembly is modeled with six individual blade boxes radiating from a central cylinder, connected to the jar base with a continuous/revolute joint. The lid is a thin Cylinder with a central rectangular cutout, inside of which a hinged valve flap (modeled as a Box) is attached via a revolute joint.
